title: Keep named source-root watcher scope alive while carried checks run after turn end
outcome: A named source root below a parent build/VCS directory remains an independently selected watcher scope for the lifetime of its running carried checks, including after the initiating turn closes.
acceptance: A behavioral test ends the initiating turn while a carried check still runs in a named root under target/ or node_modules/, then proves a real source edit still reaches the check fence and correct publication/attribution.
Build/VCS descendants below that named root remain ignored, and an unrelated ignored sibling remains suppressed.
